assets.name: Smoke measurement
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [direct] to "Fire not detected" (fatal)

properties.description: Current smoke density from the optical chamber — direct input of the alarm decision.

securityGoals.rationale: A smoke density value is not secret.

securityGoals.formalDescription: The smoke measurement shall be protected against manipulation between optical chamber and alarm decision.
The smoke measurement shall reach the alarm decision continuously; loss shall be detected and reported as a fault.
securityGoals.rationale: The alarm decision needs a continuous measurement; a lost stream must become a fault.
Single measurement values are not evidence; alarms are recorded in the audit log (DA-010).

assets.name: Calibration parameters
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [indirect] to "Fire not detected" (fatal)

properties.description: Optical calibration coefficients, sensitivity factors, reference values. Manipulation shifts every measurement — silently.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Calibration parameters shall be protected against unauthorised disclosure.
securityGoals.rationale: Coefficients are product know-how, not a security secret.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Calibration parameters shall only be changed by an authorised calibration procedure and shall be integrity-protected at rest.
Calibration parameters shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.
securityGoals.rationale: Loaded at start-up; a missing calibration leads to a fault state, not to a silent failure.

assets.name: Alarm configuration
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [direct] to "Fire not detected" (fatal)

properties.description: Alarm and pre-alarm thresholds, verification delay, zone/address assignment.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Alarm configuration shall be protected against unauthorised disclosure.
securityGoals.rationale: Thresholds are documented in the commissioning report.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Alarm thresholds, delays and zone assignment shall be integrity-protected at rest and in transit.
Alarm configuration shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.
Only authorised maintenance personnel shall change the alarm configuration.
securityGoals.rationale: Only authorised maintenance personnel may change thresholds, delays and zones.

assets.name: Controller firmware
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [indirect] to "Fire not detected" (fatal); contributes [indirect] to "Alarm not transmitted" (fatal)

properties.description: Firmware image of the controller MCU: alarm logic, protocol stacks, authentication, WLAN.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Controller firmware shall be protected against unauthorised disclosure.
Only firmware signed by the manufacturer shall be installed and executed on the controller.
Controller firmware shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.

assets.name: Sensor firmware
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [indirect] to "Fire not detected" (fatal)

properties.description: Firmware image of the sensor MCU (measurement, diagnostics, sensor-bus protocol).

securityGoals.formalDescription: Sensor firmware shall be protected against unauthorised disclosure.
Only firmware signed by the manufacturer shall be installed on the sensor head.
Sensor firmware shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.

properties.description: Maintenance password hash, Wi-Fi PSK, TLS server key.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Device credentials shall not be readable via debug ports, flash dumps or the maintenance interface.
Device credentials shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Device credentials shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.

properties.description: Network settings, device name, update server URL.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Device and network configuration shall be protected against unauthorised disclosure.
Device and network configuration shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Device and network configuration shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.

assets.name: Alarm event
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [direct] to "Alarm not transmitted" (fatal)

properties.description: Alarm / pre-alarm message with zone and address — the output of the safety function.

securityGoals.rationale: An alarm is meant to be seen.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Alarm events shall reach the fire panel unaltered.
Alarm events shall reach the fire panel within the EN 54 response time.
securityGoals.rationale: The alarm must reach the panel within the EN 54 response time.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Actions on Alarm event shall be attributable and recorded tamper-evidently.

properties.description: Heartbeat, diagnostic status (LED ageing, contamination), fault signal to the panel (EN 54).

securityGoals.rationale: Status and fault signals are not secret.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Detector status and fault signal shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Detector status and fault signal shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.
securityGoals.rationale: A missing heartbeat must be noticed by the panel.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Actions on Detector status and fault signal shall be attributable and recorded tamper-evidently.
securityGoals.rationale: Cyclic, device-internal status and fault signal: no accountability requirement — the repudiation threats on DF-3, DF-1.5 and DF-11 are rated not relevant for the same reason.

properties.description: Alarms, logins, configuration changes, updates, boot results — evidence after a fire event (liability, insurance).

securityGoals.formalDescription: Audit log shall be protected against unauthorised disclosure.
securityGoals.rationale: Contains user names and configuration history.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Audit log shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Audit log shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.
Alarms, logins, configuration changes and updates shall be recorded tamper-evidently.

assets.name: Panel commands
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [direct] to "Alarm not transmitted" (fatal)

properties.description: Reset, silence and test commands from the fire panel. Not authenticated on the loop.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Panel commands shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Actions on Panel commands shall be attributable and recorded tamper-evidently.
Reset, silence and test commands shall only be accepted from the authentic fire panel.
securityGoals.rationale: A spoofed reset or silence cancels a real alarm.

assets.name: Smoke detection
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [direct] to "Fire not detected" (fatal)

properties.description: Detect smoke reliably and in time (EN 54-7 response threshold).

securityGoals.formalDescription: Smoke detection shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Smoke detection shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.

assets.name: Alarm signalling
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [direct] to "Alarm not transmitted" (fatal)

properties.description: Signal an alarm to the fire panel — via the loop protocol and the hard-wired alarm contact.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Alarm signalling shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Alarm signalling shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.

assets.name: Fault monitoring
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [indirect] to "Fire not detected" (fatal)

properties.description: Detect and report detector faults (sensor-bus loss, contamination, LED failure) so an out-of-service detector does not go unnoticed.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Fault monitoring shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Fault monitoring shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.

properties.description: Download, verify and install controller and sensor firmware.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Firmware update shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Actions on Firmware update shall be attributable and recorded tamper-evidently.
Only authorised roles shall be able to change Firmware update.

properties.description: Technician login, threshold and network configuration, password change.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Maintenance and configuration shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Actions on Maintenance and configuration shall be attributable and recorded tamper-evidently.
Only authorised roles shall be able to change Maintenance and configuration.

properties.description: Trust anchor of the update chain — a compromise reaches every device in the field.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Firmware update server shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Firmware update server shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.
Firmware update server shall only be accepted from authenticated sources.
securityGoals.rationale: Devices must only accept updates from the authentic server.

assets.name: Controller unit
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [indirect] to "Alarm not transmitted" (fatal)

properties.description: Controller MCU with alarm evaluation, panel interface, WLAN.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Controller unit shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Controller unit shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.

assets.name: Optical sensor head
assets.physicalImpactRationale: Derived from HazardItem chain: contributes [indirect] to "Fire not detected" (fatal)

properties.description: Sensor MCU with optical chamber, calibration and diagnostics.

securityGoals.formalDescription: Optical sensor head shall be protected against unauthorised modification; manipulation shall be detected.
Optical sensor head shall be available when required; a loss shall be detected and reported.

properties.description: People in the protected area; primary protection target of the detector (EN 54).
Emergency responders who rely on the reported zone/address.
Premises and goods protected by the fire detection system.

relations.rationale: The update process installs the sensor image.
Measurement runs in the sensor firmware.
Fault reporting runs on the controller unit.
The controller has no smoke information without the sensor head.
Alarm signalling runs on the controller unit.
The update process installs the controller image.
Panel protocol and relay control run in the controller firmware.
Alarm evaluation runs in the controller firmware.
Fault monitoring evaluates heartbeat and diagnostic status.
Alarm events are written to the audit log.
Reset/silence/test change the alarm state.
Smoke measurement runs in the sensor head.
The alarm event is what is signalled.
No alarm without detection.
The update server distributes the sensor image (supply-chain path).
The update server distributes the controller image (supply-chain path).
The measurement is computed with the calibration — a wrong calibration shifts every value.
Smoke detection decides on the current measurement.
Network settings configure the controller unit.
Maintenance access is protected by the device credentials.
Thresholds are changed during maintenance.
Verification delay and zone/address shape the alarm signal.
Thresholds define when smoke is detected.

elements.description: Housing of the remote optical sensor head (smoke chamber, LED/photodiode, sensor MCU). Physical protection of the sensor parts; reachable on site, opened only for service.
elements.name: Sensor Head Enclosure [SHE]

properties.notes: Remote optical sensor head (smoke chamber, LED/photodiode, sensor MCU). Connected to the controller enclosure by a field-wired RS-485 sensor bus.

elements.description: Trust boundary of the sensor head: everything inside runs on the sensor MCU and trusts its own firmware and calibration. Crossed only by the RS-485 sensor bus and the JTAG port.
elements.name: Sensor Boundary [SB]

elements.description: Housing of the detector base / controller unit with alarm evaluation, fire-panel interface, alarm relay and WLAN. Mounted in the protected area; opened only for service.
elements.name: Controller Enclosure [CTE]

properties.notes: Detector base / controller unit: alarm evaluation, fire-panel interface, alarm relay, WLAN for maintenance and firmware updates.

elements.description: Trust boundary of the controller: the controller MCU firmware, its configuration and logs. Crossed by the sensor bus, the fire-panel loop, the alarm relay, WLAN and JTAG.
elements.name: Controller Boundary [CB]

properties.complianceRelevance: CRA Annex I §1(3) — EN 54-7 / EN 54-2 interface (alarm decision and transmission)

elements.description: The sensor head as a whole: optical smoke detection, diagnostics and the sensor side of the sensor bus. Decomposed on the page "Sensor Head".
elements.name: Sensor Head

elements.description: The smoke detector controller as a whole: alarm decision, fire-panel communication, maintenance access, logging and firmware updates. Decomposed on the page "Smoke Detector Controller".
elements.name: Smoke Detector Controller

elements.description: JTAG/SWD debug adapter at the sensor or controller MCU. Models an attacker with physical access, or a service tool left connected.
elements.name: Debug Probe

properties.notes: JTAG/SWD adapter of an attacker with physical access (or a service tool left connected).

threatProfile.rationale: Requires opening the enclosure (tool) and a JTAG adapter

elements.description: EN 54-2 fire alarm control panel of the building. Polls the detector, receives alarms and faults, sends reset / silence / test commands.
elements.name: Fire Alarm Control Panel

properties.notes: EN 54-2 control and indicating equipment, operated by the building owner.

threatProfile.rationale: Access to the detection loop requires physical access to the building wiring

elements.description: Service partner with laptop or app. Logs in to the maintenance web UI to configure alarm thresholds and network settings.
elements.name: Maintenance Technician

properties.notes: Service partner with laptop/app; configures thresholds and network settings.

threatProfile.rationale: Maintenance web UI only reachable from the site WLAN (proximity required)

elements.description: WLAN access point of the site. The controller associates to it for maintenance access and firmware downloads.
elements.name: Site Wi-Fi Access Point

threatProfile.rationale: Operated by the building owner; shared PSK, rogue AP possible within radio range

elements.description: Manufacturer backend that serves signed firmware packages for controller and sensor head over HTTPS.
elements.name: Firmware Update Server

properties.notes: Manufacturer backend; serves signed update packages over HTTPS.

threatProfile.rationale: Very high effort, but every device in the field is affected

elements.description: Drives the LED pulses, samples forward and side scatter and calculates the smoke density. Reads the calibration parameters at start-up and after recalibration.
elements.name: Optical Detection Controller

properties.notes: LED pulse control, ADC sampling of forward/side scatter, smoke density calculation. Reads calibration parameters at start-up and after recalibration.

elements.description: Sensor-head endpoint of the RS-485 sensor bus. Streams measurements and diagnostics to the controller; receives calibration parameters and the sensor firmware image.
elements.name: Sensor Communication Controller

properties.notes: Sensor-bus endpoint of the sensor head (RS-485). Streams measurements and diagnostics to the controller, receives calibration and firmware commands.

elements.description: Monitors LED ageing, chamber contamination, temperature and humidity, and reports faults (EN 54 fault signal) to the controller.
elements.name: Sensor Diagnostic Controller

properties.notes: Monitors LED ageing, chamber contamination, temperature/humidity. Reports faults (EN 54 fault signal) to the controller.

elements.description: Receives the sensor firmware image from the controller, writes it to the sensor flash and reads it back for verification.
elements.name: Sensor Update Handler

properties.notes: Receives the sensor firmware image from the controller via the sensor bus, writes it to the sensor flash and reads it back for verification.
properties.securityControls: Firmware signature check before flashing, post-flash readback

elements.description: Sensor flash holding the optical calibration coefficients, sensitivity factors and factory reference values.
elements.name: Flash: Calibration Parameters

properties.notes: Optical calibration coefficients, sensitivity factors, factory reference values.
properties.safetyRationale: Manipulated calibration = systematically wrong measurement, undetected until the next calibration check

elements.description: Sensor flash holding the firmware image of the sensor MCU.
elements.name: Flash: Sensor Firmware

elements.description: Sensor-head side of the field-wired RS-485 sensor bus (screw terminals), towards the controller.
elements.name: RS-485 Sensor Bus (Head)

properties.notes: Screw terminals of the field-wired sensor bus between sensor head and controller.

elements.description: Debug port of the sensor MCU. Enabled in production today; target state: permanently disabled.
elements.name: JTAG (Sensor MCU)

properties.notes: Gap: enabled in production. Target state: permanently disabled (fused off).

elements.description: The sensor MCU: optical detection, diagnostics, sensor bus and update handling run on it. Debug port not locked and no readout protection today.
elements.name: Sensor MCU [SMCU]

properties.notes: Gap: debug port not locked in production, no readout protection — calibration and firmware readable/writable after opening the enclosure.

elements.description: Alarm decision: compares the smoke density with the threshold, applies the verification delay and zone assignment, drives the alarm relay and the fire-panel message.
elements.name: Alarm Processing Controller

properties.notes: Alarm decision: smoke density vs. threshold, verification delay, zone assignment. Drives the alarm relay and the fire-panel message.
properties.securityControls: Watchdog, plausibility check of measurements, alarm on sensor-bus loss (fail-safe)

elements.description: Fire-panel protocol stack on the RS-485 loop: sends alarm and status messages, receives reset / silence / test commands.
elements.name: Fire Panel Communication Service

properties.notes: Fire-panel protocol stack (RS-485 loop): alarm and status messages to the panel, reset/silence/test commands from the panel. Replaceable by a 868 MHz radio module.

elements.description: Checks the maintenance login and authorises configuration changes; writes the device configuration and credentials.
elements.name: Maintenance Authentication Service

properties.notes: Checks the maintenance login and authorises configuration changes. Gap: a single shared maintenance password, no roles — every authenticated user may change thresholds and credentials.

elements.description: Root of trust: verifies the controller firmware image before execution and reports the boot result.
elements.name: Secure Boot & Firmware Validation

properties.notes: Root of trust: verifies the controller image before execution and reports the boot result.

elements.description: WLAN driver in station mode towards the site access point, using the Wi-Fi PSK from the device configuration.
elements.name: Wi-Fi Manager

properties.notes: WLAN driver (IEEE 802.11 b/g/n): station mode towards the site access point. Uses the Wi-Fi PSK from the device configuration flash. Does not terminate TLS.

elements.description: Persists security-relevant events — alarms, logins, updates, boot results, WLAN events — as evidence after a fire event.
elements.name: Audit & Event Logging Service

properties.notes: Persists security-relevant events (alarms, logins, updates, boot results, WLAN events) — evidence after a fire event (EN 54, CRA).

elements.description: HTTPS endpoint of the controller: serves the maintenance web UI and downloads update packages from the firmware update server.
elements.name: Controller Communication Handler

properties.notes: HTTPS endpoint of the controller: maintenance web UI (server) and update download (client). Hands logins to P-3.3 Maintenance Authentication Service and downloads to P-3.8 Firmware Update Manager.
properties.securityControls: TLS 1.2+: server certificate for the maintenance web UI, server-certificate validation towards the update server

elements.description: Downloads and verifies the update package (signature, rollback counter), writes the controller image and forwards the sensor image to the sensor head.
elements.name: Firmware Update Manager

properties.notes: Downloads the update package via the Communication Handler, verifies signature and rollback counter, writes the controller image to flash and forwards the sensor image to the sensor head.
properties.securityControls: Firmware signature check, rollback counter, A/B image fallback

elements.description: Controller flash holding alarm thresholds, pre-alarm level, verification delay and zone/address assignment.
elements.name: Flash: Alarm Configuration

properties.notes: Alarm thresholds, pre-alarm level, verification delay, zone/address assignment.
properties.safetyRationale: Manipulated threshold or delay = no alarm, delayed alarm or false alarm

elements.description: Controller flash holding the maintenance password hash, Wi-Fi PSK, TLS key and network settings.
elements.name: Flash: Device Config & Credentials

properties.notes: Maintenance password hash, Wi-Fi PSK, TLS key, network settings.

elements.description: Tamper-evident audit log (ring buffer with hash chain) in the controller flash.
elements.name: Flash: Audit Log

properties.notes: Ring buffer with hash chain (tamper-evident). Oldest entries are overwritten.

elements.description: Controller flash holding the firmware image of the controller MCU.
elements.name: Flash: Controller Firmware

elements.description: Debug port of the controller MCU. Enabled in production today; target state: permanently disabled.
elements.name: JTAG (Controller MCU)

properties.notes: Gap: enabled in production. Target state: permanently disabled (fused off).

elements.description: Controller side of the field-wired RS-485 sensor bus (terminals), towards the sensor head.
elements.name: RS-485 Sensor Bus (Controller)

properties.notes: Controller-side terminals of the sensor bus.

elements.description: RS-485 detection loop between the controller and the fire alarm control panel.
elements.name: Fire Panel Bus (RS-485)

properties.notes: Detection loop to the fire alarm control panel.

elements.description: Potential-free alarm contact, wired to the conventional zone input of the fire panel.
elements.name: Alarm Relay Output

properties.notes: Potential-free alarm contact, wired to the conventional zone input of the fire panel.

elements.description: WLAN radio (IEEE 802.11, WPA2/WPA3-Personal), always on, used for maintenance access and firmware downloads.
elements.name: WLAN 802.11

properties.notes: WPA2/WPA3-Personal. Always on — also outside maintenance windows. No protection against de-authentication or jamming.

elements.description: The controller MCU: alarm processing, communication, maintenance and update services run on it. Secure boot is in place; the debug port is still enabled.
elements.name: Controller MCU [CMCU]

properties.notes: Secure boot verifies the controller image (P-8). Debug port still enabled — see JTAG interface.

hazards.description: Smoke is present but the detector does not reach the alarm state (blinded or manipulated measurement, raised threshold, wrong calibration, compromised firmware, out-of-service detector not noticed).
hazards.label: Fire not detected
hazards.rationale: Fire and toxic smoke spread without evacuation — EN 54-7 detection function lost.

hazards.description: The detector decides on alarm but the fire panel does not receive it (loop message suppressed or spoofed reset/silence, relay path manipulated, panel interface compromised).
hazards.label: Alarm not transmitted
hazards.rationale: Panel does not trigger sounders, fire brigade call or extinguishing — same consequence as a missed detection.

hazards.description: The alarm is raised too late (verification delay or pre-alarm stage extended, alarm held back by the firmware).
hazards.label: Delayed alarm
hazards.rationale: Available safe egress time shrinks; harm grows with the delay.

hazards.description: Alarm without fire (threshold lowered, calibration shifted, spoofed test command, manipulated firmware) — unwarranted evacuation, possible release of an automatic extinguishing system, loss of trust in alarms.
hazards.label: False alarm
hazards.rationale: Panic and falls during evacuation; repeated false alarms lead to alarms being ignored or detectors being switched off.

hazards.description: The alarm reaches the panel with a wrong zone/address (manipulated zone assignment, altered alarm message).
hazards.label: Wrong fire location reported
hazards.rationale: Responders search the wrong area; rescue and firefighting are delayed.

relations.rationale: The detection function itself decides on the alarm state.
A suppressed or falsified measurement never crosses the threshold.
A raised alarm threshold disables detection for real fires.
Manipulated calibration lowers the sensitivity systematically.
Compromised controller firmware can suppress the alarm decision.
Compromised sensor firmware can report clean air.
An unreported fault leaves a dead detector in place.
Sensor head out of service (bus cut, removed).
No evacuation in case of fire.
Fire spreads unnoticed; late intervention.
Alarm signalling is the transmission function.
A dropped or altered alarm event never reaches the panel.
A spoofed reset/silence command cancels the alarm at the panel.
Compromised firmware can block panel protocol and relay.
Controller unit out of service.
No evacuation although smoke was detected.
No fire brigade call.
Verification delay and pre-alarm stage are configuration values.
Firmware can hold back a decided alarm.
Smoke inhalation during late evacuation.
Later intervention, larger fire damage.
The alarm signal triggers evacuation and controls.
A lowered threshold causes nuisance alarms.
Shifted calibration raises the measured value.
A spoofed test command triggers an alarm.
Injuries during an unwarranted evacuation.
Production stop, call-out costs, extinguishing agent release.
Zone/address assignment is part of the alarm configuration.
The alarm event carries zone and address.
Firefighters deployed into the wrong area.
Delayed rescue of trapped occupants.

info.description: Leveled DFD example: the single-page Smoke Detector split into a System page (MP-1 Sensor Head, MP-2 Smoke Detector Controller) and one child page per multiprocess. Original cell ids are kept, so threats, risks and assets refer to the same logical elements; context copies are linked in dfd.pages.
info.name: Smoke Detector (leveled)

risks.attackDescription: Attacker disrupts communication; without a defined fail-safe state, outputs may drive actuators dangerously
risks.causeDescription: No deterministic fail-safe output state defined — actuator outputs are unpredictable under fault

proposedMitigations.text: Define and implement a deterministic fail-safe output state for all process outputs (CR 3.6)
Implement integrity controls and checksums

proposedVerifications.text: Test fail-safe output state under simulated attack or communication loss — verify defined safe state is reached
Integrity check validation testing

risks.riskAfterRationale: With a defined safe state an internal error leads to a fault signal: likelihood unchanged, safety impact 4 -> 2 (fault reported, no silent failure). Operation and compliance impact fall with it (detector reports a fault instead of a wrong value).
risks.riskBeforeRationale: Triggered by corrupted calibration or bus frames (field-accessible bus, no authentication). Without a defined safe state the smoke density may be wrong -> missed or false alarm (safety 4).

selectedMitigations.notes: Define the safe state: on internal error the function signals a fault (EN 54) instead of an undefined value.
MAC/CRC over measurement and calibration inputs, checked at start-up and before use; mismatch -> fault signal.

risks.threatDescription: Undefined fail-safe output state — process outputs reach arbitrary values on communication loss
risks.treatmentJustification: Reduce: 2 measure(s) selected; residual risk Medium (5.6) accepted after implementation.

risks.attackDescription: Attacker disrupts communication; without a defined fail-safe state, outputs may drive actuators dangerously
risks.causeDescription: No deterministic fail-safe output state defined — actuator outputs are unpredictable under fault

proposedMitigations.text: Define and implement a deterministic fail-safe output state for all process outputs (CR 3.6)
Implement integrity controls and checksums

proposedVerifications.text: Test fail-safe output state under simulated attack or communication loss — verify defined safe state is reached
Integrity check validation testing

risks.riskAfterRationale: Safe state on frame errors (fault instead of stale or arbitrary values): safety impact 4 -> 2. Operation and compliance impact fall with it (detector reports a fault instead of a wrong value).
risks.riskBeforeRationale: Bus endpoint reachable from the field wiring; undefined outputs on frame errors can forward wrong values to the controller. No asset impact derived; rated as safety function.

selectedMitigations.notes: Define the safe state: on internal error the function signals a fault (EN 54) instead of an undefined value.
MAC/CRC over received bus frames, checked at start-up and before use; mismatch -> fault signal.

risks.threatDescription: Undefined fail-safe output state — process outputs reach arbitrary values on communication loss
risks.treatmentJustification: Reduce: 2 measure(s) selected; residual risk Medium (5.6) accepted after implementation.

risks.attackDescription: Attacker disrupts communication to the safety system causing it to fail safe or fail dangerous
risks.causeDescription: Safety-critical communication has no redundant path and lacks DoS protection

proposedMitigations.text: Implement rate limiting and throttling
Use ACLs or filtering to restrict access
Implement physical protection (ESD protection, overcurrent protection, fuses)
Implement rate limiting and lockout on interface to prevent brute-force and flooding attacks

proposedVerifications.text: Stress testing and load testing (k6, JMeter)
Test interface resilience — apply electrical stress and verify protection mechanisms activate
